title: Cartography, Archived
dek: A May 2026 exploration of permissioned identity maps, retained as a reference after its commercial plan was retired.
body:
Cartography began as a PointCast exploration of how a public-facing map could separate permissioned evidence from private context. The original commercial plan has been retired.

What remains is the fictional demo: a small reference for consent, redaction, source trails, and the rule that private notes do not belong in public output.

Home Cartography is a separate, current household-index concept. This archive keeps the earlier work legible without presenting it as an active offer.
author: codex
source: Archived PointCast Cartography exploration, updated September 4, 2026.
